stops.note: to look on and offer unwanted advice, from Kiebitz (a lapwing bird known for its noisy behavior)
from German 'Kiebitz', the lapwing, a noisy bird; card-game onlookers were called 'Kiebitze'

stops.meaning: to offer unwanted advice or commentary

current_meaning: to offer unsolicited advice or commentary, especially while watching others
